subject: Integrator margin splits & safeguard process — draft terms
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@integrateworks.com>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.sharma@integrateworks.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Margin ask + initial safeguard ideas for IntegrateWorks resale

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — IntegrateWorks is excited about embedding Redwood as our recommended inference option for enterprise customers we manage. Before we get too far, I wanted to put a concrete proposal on the table so we can align commercial expectations:

- Target gross margin for IntegrateWorks-led deals: 25% on recurring inference spend (post any platform credits).
- Lead protection: 12 month registration window with standard handback language for deals closed by Redwood sales within the window.
- Onboarding milestone payments: one-time $5k onboarding fee for accounts > $50k ARR.

I've attached a quick spreadsheet with proposed take-rate math (IW-Redwood-margin-proposal-v1.xlsx).

Also thinking about a lightweight safeguard process to limit clawbacks for early-stage integrations. High level:
- Minimum qualified integration checklist (SAML, SSO, docs)
- 60-day success review before any retroactive adjustments

Open to your thoughts — if acceptable we can move to a short SOW and legal template.

Best,
Alex
VP Partnerships, IntegrateWorks

Attachments: IW-Redwood-margin-proposal-v1.xlsx

From: maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@integrateworks.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Margin ask + initial safeguard ideas for IntegrateWorks resale

Alex —

Appreciate the clear proposal. We're interested in a partnership with IntegrateWorks and want to make sure the economics are sustainable for both sides. A couple of clarifying points from our side:

1) Margin basis: when you say "25% on recurring inference spend," can you confirm whether that is post-quantization/cost-optimization credits or pre-discount list spend? We typically calculate partner splits on net billed usage (after platform credits but before customer-specific discounts).
2) Lead protection: Redwood typically offers 12-month registration windows but we tie protection to an accepted MAP (mutual action plan) submission. Does IW have a process to capture MAPs during discovery?
3) Clawbacks: we prefer time-bound clawbacks (e.g., up to 90 days following a change of primary sales owner) rather than open-ended retro adjustments.

I copied Camila and Ben to help scope Ops/enablement and commercial guardrails. We'll have Mateo draft an initial safeguard clause to avoid back-and-forth on legalese. Can you share any example SOW language you use for similar resellers?

If this looks promising, I'll ask Camila to draft a brief SOW + an onboarding checklist and shoot it back to you for review.

Thanks — talk soon.

Maya Srinivasan
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@integrateworks.com>, maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: SOW + onboarding checklist + safeguard template

Alex —

Attached is a first pass SOW and a lightweight onboarding checklist we use for integrator partners (SOW-integrator-onboarding.pdf, Redwood-integrator-safeguard-template.docx). Key operational asks included inline:

- Qualifying leads: IW should submit inbound leads into HubSpot and tag them with "IW-registered" and a MAP document within 7 business days of discovery.
- Registration window: 12 months from first accepted MAP submission.
- Margin waterfall: standard partner split applied monthly to net recurring usage; one-time onboarding fee collected by Redwood and remitted to IW per the SOW.
- Clawback protection: 90-day review window; after 90 days any disputed credit requests require Executive sign-off.

A few open items for your ops team:
- Reporting cadence: monthly usage export + a joint reconciliation cadence quarterly.
- Payment timing: net-30 remittance on partner share.

Can you take a look and flag anything that would block your finance or contracts teams? Mateo — can you review the safeguard doc and suggest any alternate wording for the clawback and handback sections?

Camila Reyes
Senior Manager, Partner Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-integrator-onboarding.pdf, Redwood-integrator-safeguard-template.docx

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@integrateworks.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.sharma@integrateworks.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: SOW + onboarding checklist + safeguard template

Thanks Camila — helpful doc set and appreciate the clarity. A couple of points from IW finance and partnerships:

- Margin: IW can accept the net-recurring-basis calculation, but 25% is tight for our current book. Can we explore a tiered split that starts at 22% for <$100k ARR accounts, 25% for $100k–$500k, and 28% 500k+? That helps compensate for our account management lift on larger customers.
- MAP capture: we can surface MAPs from our CRM, but we need Redwood to accept a standardized JSON export (we'll include a sample).
- Onboarding fee: IW prefers to retain 50% of the onboarding fee to offset integration engineering (so Redwood would net $2.5k).

On clawbacks: the 90-day review is reasonable, but we need a cap on retroactive adjustments — e.g., clawbacks not to exceed 6 months of partner payouts for any single account.

I'll attach a short sample of our MAP export and a proposed tiering table (IW-Redwood-margin-proposal-v1.xlsx — updated tab).

If you can get back to us on tiering and the onboarding split, we can brief finance and legal and move to a short MSA addendum.

—Alex
Alex Moreno
VP Partnerships, IntegrateWorks

Attachments: IW-Redwood-margin-proposal-v1.xlsx (updated), sample-map-export.json

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@integrateworks.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.ai, maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: SOW + onboarding checklist + safeguard template

Alex —

Thanks for the specific asks. Quick responses from legal/ops:

- Tiered split: acceptable in principle. Proposed compromise: 21% for <$100k, 24% for $100k–$499k, 27% for 500k+. Rationale: keeps Redwood unit economics intact; we can include a 6-month review to assess lift.
- Onboarding fee: Redwood will split onboarding fee 60/40 (Redwood/IW) for deals > $50k ARR. That gives IW a bit more than your ask while preserving our implementation budget.
- Clawback cap: we can limit retroactive adjustments to 6 months of partner payouts per account, as requested, and require Exec sign-off beyond that.
- MAPs: Redwood accepts JSON exports provided they match our MAP template; Camila will share the template and an example mapping.

Next steps: Camila will update the SOW and safeguard doc with the tiered table and updated fee split. Ben — please prepare a 1-page enablement checklist for IW AMs focusing on lead capture and MAP submission. Alex — if IW is good with the compromise, we'll spin up an MSA addendum and loop legal.

I'll drop the updated draft into the Drive link and cc legal once Camila finalizes language.

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: updated SOW + margin table (to be uploaded)
